name: Trint
description:
Trint turns audio and video into searchable, editable transcripts. This connector lets Claude work directly with the content in your Trint account.

With it, Claude can:
* Search across your files (transcripts, narratives, and captions) with filters for workspace, folder, file type, speaker, creator, and date ranges.
* Read transcripts and content, optionally scoped to a specific time range.
* Browse your workspaces and folders and look up file, folder, and workspace details.
* Find quote timecodes, map any quote back to its exact position, speaker, and a deep link into the Trint editor.
* Play media inline, render an audio/video player for a file or a specific quote, right in the conversation.

All actions run against your own Trint account using your authenticated access, and respect the permissions already set on your files and workspaces.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trint.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trint provides these MCP tools: get_file_content, get_file_metadata, get_folder_metadata, get_suggestions, get_times_from_quotes, get_workspace_metadata, list_workspaces, render_file_player, render_quote_player, save_suggestions, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trint in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Trint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trint is developed by Trint Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
